headline: CVS Health Plans to Split into Two Separate Companies
summary: Healthcare giant CVS Health announced plans to split its business into two separate entities. The move surprised analysts and caused the company's stock price to decline.
why: Corporate breakups can unlock shareholder value by allowing distinct business units to operate independently, though they often entail substantial restructuring costs and strategic uncertainty.

impacts.name: CVS Health
impacts.why: The input states that the company's stock is down following the breakup announcement.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
